Parvati Ki Tapasya — Shiv Ka Dil Jeeta! ❤️

🔱 Parvati penance to win Lord Shiva love divine marriage

After Sati's death, Shiva withdrew into deep meditation. Parvati, Sati's reincarnation, performed extreme tapas for thousands of years to win Shiva's love — surviving on no food, then only leaves, then air alone. Shiva tested her repeatedly but she persisted, eventually melting his heart.
